title: Kafka message envelope
description: Every upstat.* message on the CueLABS shared bus (decisions.md X-11). Every product can read the lanes, so producers write the payload to the Upstat storage prefix and send `data_ref` (system-design.md §5.4). `data` stays valid for tests and fixtures; exactly one of the two is set.

type.description: The event name, which is also the name of the schema `data` must match.

version.description: <major>.<minor>: a minor change only adds optional fields; consumers reject a major they don't support.

id.description: Message id; consumers deduplicate on it.

request_id.description: The piece of work: set on every request and kept on re-send; every result carries its request's. The owner keeps the first result per request_id.
